The '''Cartusio system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that was home to the [[Cartusion whale/Legends|Cartusion whale]].<ref name="A Test of Strength" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Cartusio system was established in [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]], which placed the system in grid square J-12.<ref name="EAOC" />
